title: Autocomplete dropdown does not appear for a 1-character query
steps: Navigate to https://dev.skyline.glass/
Click the header search input to focus it
Type "g" using real keystroke events (not programmatic fill)
expected_result: No autocomplete dropdown appears below the search input.

title: Autocomplete dropdown does not appear for a 2-character query
steps: Navigate to https://dev.skyline.glass/
Click the header search input to focus it
Type "gl" using real keystroke events
expected_result: No autocomplete dropdown appears below the search input.

title: Autocomplete dropdown appears with suggestions for a 3-character query
steps: Navigate to https://dev.skyline.glass/
Click the header search input to focus it
Type "gla" using real keystroke events
expected_result: Autocomplete dropdown appears showing matching suggestions plus an "All results" link.

title: Autocomplete suggestion list is capped at approximately 7 items plus an "All results" link
steps: Navigate to https://dev.skyline.glass/
Click the header search input to focus it
Type "glass" using real keystroke events
Count the suggestion items rendered in the dropdown
expected_result: Dropdown shows no more than ~7 suggestion items, followed by a single "All results" link at the bottom of the dropdown.

title: Autocomplete suggestions update as the user continues typing
steps: Navigate to https://dev.skyline.glass/
Click the header search input to focus it
Type "gla" using real keystroke events and record the suggestions shown
Continue typing to "glas" without clearing the field
expected_result: Suggestion list refreshes to reflect the updated, narrower query each time, with no page reload required.

title: Autocomplete dropdown closes when the search input is cleared
steps: Navigate to https://dev.skyline.glass/
Click the header search input to focus it
Type "gla" using real keystroke events and confirm the dropdown is open
Clear the input field completely
